name: mengke-wang/xiaohongshu-ai-workbench
description: A Xiaohongshu operations workbench and handbook collection, including title generation and diagnosis, profile skills, and a suite skill, plus comment-reply automation, for planning and running Xiaohongshu content.
install: Download a .skill file from packages/ and import it into Codex, or manually copy the skill folder to the skills directory; a clone-for-development route is also documented
